name: Deadman's Crossing
summary: At Deadman's Crossing, travelers still follow the packed road beneath a tree hung with the dead. The junction in Deadwind Pass links Duskwood, the Swamp of Sorrows, and the track to Karazhan, carrying travelers across the southern Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Grim Intersection
sections.body:
Deadman's Crossing joins the roads through eastern Deadwind Pass. The western road runs toward Duskwood and the eastern road toward the Swamp of Sorrows. South, a track climbs toward Karazhan. At the fork stands a twisted hangman's tree, its branches bearing two rotting corpses.

Battered wooden signs warn travelers to turn back and abandon hope. Hostile beasts and dark sorceries haunt the canyon, yet the packed dirt road through the crossing remains clear. Travelers who keep to it avoid the blighted rocks.

faq.q: Where does each road lead from Deadman's Crossing?
faq.answer: The western road from Deadman's Crossing leads to Duskwood, and the eastern road leads to the Swamp of Sorrows. The winding southern path crosses Deadwind Pass toward Karazhan.

faq.q: Who are the corpses hanging from the tree?
faq.answer: No one knows who the corpses were. Deadwind Pass has claimed countless wanderers, bandits, and refugees over the years. Someone raised the gallows tree as a grim boundary marker to warn travelers away.

faq.q: Is Deadman's Crossing safe for travelers?
aliases: will i get attacked on the road
faq.answer: The crossing and main east-west road are clear, though vicious vultures, ghosts, and ogres fill the surrounding crags and caves. Couriers and adventurers can pass between Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows safely by staying on the dirt path.

faq.q: What do the signs at the crossing say?
faq.answer: One weathered sign reads, “Turn Back!” Another warns, “Abandon hope, all ye who enter here.” Both caution travelers about the valley’s dangers.

angles.text: As an Alliance courier traveling from Darkshire to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands, you can take the quickest route through Deadman's Crossing. The road is unnerving.
As a Horde wanderer traveling west from Stonard toward Duskwood, you pass this grim landmark on the way into the blighted human lands.
